transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um… I guess I’m here because I’ve been feeling pretty down on myself lately. I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, but I keep thinking I’ve let my family down, especially with taking on this mortgage. And then at work, even little mistakes feel like proof that I’m… useless, I guess. Like I deserve whatever happens because I messed things up. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
How long have you been feeling this way?

I mean… it’s been going on for a while. I probably should’ve come in sooner, but I kept thinking I could just handle it. The really down, guilty feeling has been there on and off for about a year and two months, I’d say. Does that sound like the kind of timeframe you’re asking for?
Have you noticed any changes in your interest in activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah… I mean, maybe a little. I still do my job and everything, so it’s not like I’ve completely stopped. But I used to joke around more with the regulars, and I’d usually text my brother after my shifts.

Lately I kind of just… keep my face straight, say what I need to say, and go home. And messages, I don’t know, they just sit there because I don’t really feel that pull to answer. Is that what you mean by interest?
Do you still find pleasure in the activities you're doing, even if you're not as enthusiastic about them as you used to be?

I’m not totally sure how to answer that. I mean… I don’t hate doing things, exactly. Like at work I can still get through a shift, and sometimes there are moments that are fine. But pleasure… I don’t know, it feels kind of muted, I guess.

Maybe that’s a normal way to put it? Like I’m doing the activities, but I’m not getting as much out of them as I used to.
Have you noticed any changes in your weight recently?

A little, maybe… I haven’t been tracking it closely, so I don’t want to overstate it. My eating’s just been kind of inconsistent. Some weeks I barely touch the staff meal at work, and then other nights I’ll get home and just eat whatever’s in the kitchen, more to feel settled than because I’m really hungry.

I’m not sure if that counts as a weight change, but that’s what I’ve noticed.
Have you felt down or depressed for most of the day, nearly every day, over the past two years?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound dramatic, because I still show up and do what I’m supposed to do.

But most days there’s this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Like I’m carrying plates, smiling when I’m supposed to smile, saying the right things… but it’s more like going through the motions than actually feeling okay.

Does that count as depressed?
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?

I’m not sure, honestly. There are things I still do, like maybe watching something after work or listening to music, but I don’t know if I’d call it enjoyment exactly.

It’s more like… it passes the time, and sometimes that’s enough. I don’t want to make it sound like nothing ever feels okay, because that’s not totally true. But I can’t really think of something where I’m like, yeah, I’m excited for that. Does that make sense?
Are there any activities where you feel a sense of pleasure or enjoyment, even if it's not as strong as it used to be?

Maybe a little? I don’t want to say there’s nothing at all. Like, sometimes if a song comes on that I used to like, I’ll feel… okay for a minute. Or if a show is funny enough, I might laugh.

It’s just not the same as it used to be, I guess. It doesn’t really stick. But yeah, there are small moments like that. Is that what you mean?
Are there any activities where you feel as much pleasure as you used to?

As much as I used to? Um… probably not, no.

I don’t want to sound too negative, because I do have moments where something feels nice or I laugh a little. But if you mean really feeling the same kind of enjoyment or looking forward to things the way I used to… I can’t really think of anything like that right now. Is that an okay answer?
Are there any activities that you still look forward to?

Not really in the same way. I mean, I still go to work and I’m polite, and I’ll answer people if they talk to me, so it’s not like I’m just… shut off completely.

But I used to kind of look forward to seeing certain regulars, joking around with them, or texting my brother after a shift about something funny that happened. Lately I mostly just keep my face straight, say what I need to say, and when messages come in I let them sit. It’s not that I’m trying to be rude, I just don’t really feel that pull to answer.

I don’t know if that counts as not looking forward to things, but… that’s probably the honest answer.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to care about?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to make it sound like I don’t care about anything at all, because that feels harsh.

But I used to joke around with the regulars at work, or text my brother after a shift if something funny happened. Lately I mostly just keep a straight face, say what I need to say, and then go home. If he texts, I’ll often just let it sit there. Not because I’m mad or trying to ignore him… I just don’t feel that pull to answer like I used to.

So, yeah, I guess I have lost interest some. Does that make sense?
Have you had two years or more where you felt down or depressed most of the time?

Two years or more? No… I don’t think it’s been that long.

It’s still been a while, though. Maybe about a year and a couple months where these down periods, and feeling guilty, have been there a lot of the time. I don’t want to overstate it, but… around a year and two months sounds right.
Have you had periods of feeling down or depressed like this before, or is this the first time?

I don’t think I had anything quite like this before, not for this long anyway.

I mean, I’ve had normal low points like anybody, but this stretch where I’m down and feeling guilty a lot… that’s been more like about a year and two months. I hope I’m answering that the right way.
Have you had a period of feeling down or depressed like this before?

Not really, no… I mean, I’ve had days or weeks where I was sad or stressed, like anyone, but I don’t think I’ve had a period like this before.

At least, not that I can remember in the same way. This feels more… ongoing, I guess. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking?
Have you had any periods of feeling significantly down or depressed before this current episode?

Before this? No, I don’t think so… not in a significant way.

I’ve had rough times, but this current stretch is the one that’s really stayed with me. The depressed and guilty periods have been around for, I guess, about a year and two months now. I hope that makes sense.
Have you had a period of feeling down or depressed like this before that went away and then came back?

I don’t think it really went away and came back, no. It’s more like… most days there’s this heavy, empty feeling in my chest.

I still go to work and carry plates and smile because I’m supposed to, so maybe it doesn’t look that bad from the outside. But it feels like I’m just going through the motions, not really because I feel anything good. Does that answer what you mean?
Have you had any other periods in your life where you felt down or depressed like this before?

No, I don’t think so. I mean, I’ve had normal bad patches, like stress or feeling low for a bit, but nothing that felt like this or lasted like this.

I’m trying to answer that correctly… I just don’t remember another time where it was really the same.
Have you had any periods of feeling down or depressed like this before that completely went away for a while?

No, I don’t think it ever completely went away for a while. It’s more like most days there’s still that heavy, empty feeling in my chest.

I can still do my job, carry plates, smile at customers and all that, so I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is… but it feels like I’m just doing what I’m supposed to do, not because I actually feel good. Does that make sense?
Have you had any other episodes of feeling down or depressed like this before?

I don’t think I’ve had other episodes like this, no. It’s more just been this same kind of low feeling most days… like a heavy, empty feeling in my chest.

I still function, you know, I go to work and carry plates and smile when I’m supposed to, so I don’t want to make it sound dramatic. But it doesn’t feel like I’m really feeling anything good. I’m mostly just going through the motions.
Have you had any episodes of feeling down or depressed like this before that completely went away?

No, not really… I don’t think there was a time where it fully went away and then came back as a separate episode.

It’s more like, most days, there’s just this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. I still go to work and carry plates and smile because I’m supposed to, and I can manage that, so I don’t want to overstate it… but it doesn’t feel like I’m actually feeling anything good. It’s more like I’m just getting through it.
